title: Who made what
lede: The full list of original works, fonts, libraries, and assets used by this site, with their licenses.
original: Shikaku (シカク) © Tatsuki Fujimoto / Shueisha. First published in Jump SQ.19 (2014); English edition by VIZ Media in Tatsuki Fujimoto Before Chainsaw Man: 17-21.
Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 anime © respective rights holders; distributed by Avex Pictures and Prime Video. The trailer plays directly from the official YouTube channel.
made: Every illustration (Yugeru & Shikaku silhouettes, the symbolic meal, the empty chair, teacups, the burning figure, the trailer poster) is drawn as original SVG/canvas.
Paper texture, noise, and ink splatter are generated with SVG feTurbulence.
All sound effects are synthesized in real time with the Web Audio API; no third-party audio files.
The CRT shader, execution simulation, kanji particle morph, and quiz result card were written from scratch.
All wiki text is original paraphrase and analysis; no manga dialogue is copied.
sources: Release facts were verified against the official anime site, VIZ Media, Prime Video's announcement, the avex pictures YouTube channel, and Wikipedia. See also the Production page in the wiki.
license: This site's code was built as a non-commercial fan portfolio.
